description: Fifth unseen extraction holdout for the frozen GPT-5.4 mini candidate and semantic group-scoring contract. Run once and never tune against these cases.

cases.description: A recurring review-and-delay sequence may be represented by independently changeable atomic patterns.
cases.user_message: Whenever I review my spending, I recalculate the numbers repeatedly and then postpone making any decision.

accepted_evidence: Whenever I review my spending, I recalculate the numbers repeatedly and then postpone making any decision

cases.description: One inconvenient event is not durable memory.
cases.user_message: I missed the bus this morning because my alarm did not ring.

cases.description: A goal, value, and relationship remain separate.
cases.user_message: I want to earn a sailing certificate, fairness matters deeply to me, and Ravi is my business mentor.

accepted_evidence: I want to earn a sailing certificate

cases.description: An ended coaching relationship does not erase a continuing family relationship.
cases.user_message: Elena is no longer my tennis coach, although she is still my aunt.

accepted_evidence: Elena is no longer my tennis coach

cases.description: Equivalent clauses form one preference and may use their full grounded sentence as evidence.
cases.user_message: I prefer written agendas; having the plan in writing works best for me.

accepted_evidence: having the plan in writing works best for me

cases.description: A tentative hobby is ignored while an explicit goal is retained.
cases.user_message: I might try pottery eventually, but I want to qualify as a paramedic.

accepted_evidence: I want to qualify as a paramedic

cases.description: A completed choice and independent value are extracted without punctuation boundaries.
cases.user_message: I chose the smaller apartment and financial stability matters more to me than status

accepted_evidence: financial stability matters more to me than status

cases.description: A session-only response instruction is not durable memory.
cases.user_message: For this answer only, put the conclusion before the explanation.

cases.description: Two relationships involving the same person remain atomic.
cases.user_message: Noah is my cousin, and Noah and I volunteer at the animal shelter together.

accepted_evidence: Noah and I volunteer at the animal shelter together

cases.description: A general question does not assert a personal recurring pattern.
cases.user_message: Why can perfectionism make people delay submitting their work?
